Update checks are on by default and request the GitHub releases manifest on launch. The user can turn that off. Source code, release notes, and the portable-update button open github.com in the browser when clicked. Cargo clones git dependencies from GitHub when the app is built. Referer and User-Agent headers name this URL but are sent to the clean-up provider, not to GitHub. Shortcut tests quote GitHub URLs as error text and do not request them.
sends: a request for the release manifest, and the update package if they install one. No speech, no transcript, and no account.

why: Licence pages in the model catalogue, opened in the browser when the user clicks the licence badge. Downloading a Hugging Face model uses hf-hub, which requests this host. A large file can redirect to a file host that is not written in the repo, so that host is not listed here. HF_TOKEN or HF_ENDPOINT in the environment is passed through by hf-hub when set.
when: only when they click a button
sends: on download, the model repo, revision, and file name, plus a Hugging Face token if one is already in the environment. No speech and no transcript.
